show-notes.show_notes: Episode 42 features an in-depth conversation with Sarah Chen, CEO and founder of DataFlow AI, discussing the technical challenges of building scalable machine learning infrastructure. Key topics include distributed computing architectures, handling data privacy in AI systems, and the evolution of neural network frameworks. Sarah shares insights on how her team solved complex problems with tensor processing units and describes their approach to maintaining model accuracy while scaling operations. The discussion delves into real-world applications of federated learning and explores the future of edge computing in artificial intelligence. This episode is essential for technical leaders, ML engineers, and anyone interested in the practical implementation of cutting-edge AI technologies.
